instagram.author: ashambihaipahar
instagram.body:
Labor has introduced legislation to ban subscription traps, hidden fees and drip pricing! 

I’m sure nearly everyone has experienced this in one way or another, whether it is confusing charges, sneaky traps or cancellation systems designed to wear people down. We’re all sick of it, and this reform is designed to put a stop to it!
- Are you sure? Yes.
- Would 10% off change your mind?
- Ah, no.
- Are you sure sure?
- Yes.
- Would you like to speak to a chatbot named Sam?
- No.
- Labour's introduced legislation to ban unfair trading practices. This means cracking down on subscription traps, drip pricing and also dodgy designs. If a business needs confusion, hidden fees or even consumer exhaustion to make money, that's not fair trading. It's a trap.

instagram.author: _eva_maya_
instagram.body:
I don’t trust myself to remember everything. I need things to be automated because I am not a sufficient system alone. I want to spend less time doing dumb things when they could be automated so I can spend more time doing human things of deeper value than copying and pasting numbers in a finance app or setting reminders to catch-up with people. 

I’m sick of it and I’m doing something about it. 

I also detest subscriptions with a passion so when this works, it’ll be free to prove it works, then it’ll be a one-time buy like in the old days. I get supported to continue building other useful things and you don’t get eaten away by subscriptions. What a stupid system. 

#build #automate #automation #os #smart
I can't feel my face when I'm with you but I love it, but I love it.

tiktok.author: katbernard_
tiktok.body:
Someone explain it to me like I’m 5. #subscriptions #sickofit
You know what? I'm sick of that everything is a subscription. Do you guys remember when you could buy Microsoft Office and get, like, word and Excel and, like, Powerpoint and I don't even know how much it was. It was like $99. And you would have it indefinitely, right? Like, you would download it on your computer, and then you're done. Donezo. Do you know there's a subscription every year? Yeah, there is. I just saw that there's one for heated seats in the vehicle that you own. Look, I can understand when you're continuously providing value, like, I don't know, streaming services, even though they're getting out of hand. Like, can we just go back to cable music services again? All of that stuff, right? You're continuously getting new content, new things to listen to, new things to watch. So it makes sense. And I get it, right? This is the how they make money. This is such a great business strategy. But you wanna know what it is? It's renting. It is renting, you guys. It is not owning your house. It is renting. And we all know how we feel about renting. You wanna get out of that situation and start owning? Honestly, at this point, they're gonna start charging us to breathe. Are you kidding me? Oh, wait, they already do, because we pay monthly insurance premiums, and most of us probably never use it. But also, even if you do use it, you still Have to pay on top of that. Okay, that's a conversation for another day. I gotta go.
